newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo bourse applies to list two parts firms.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo bourse applies to list two parts firms.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Wednesday it had applied to the Finance Ministry to list car component maker Ikuyo Co Ltd and electrical parts maker Tokyo Denpa Co Ltd on its second section.

Ikuyo's listing is targeted for March 18. It will offer 700,000 new shares as well as 300,000 existing shares, the TSE said in a statement. Ikuyo registered its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) market in August 1995.
Tokyo Denpa, whose shares have been trading on the OTC market since April 1995, is aiming for a February 18 listing. It will not issue any new shares, the TSE said.
